description: Deprecated — use get_supply_state, which is enveloped with a validated ledger index, per-value claim statuses, exact decimal strings and degraded codes. Current on-chain stats for the ASTEROID token on the XRP Ledger: total supply (including escrowed tokens), holder count, issuer XRP balance, and the balance and supply share of the project-declared takeover qualifying wallet. Wallet labels describe owner-confirmed declared roles only.
